review.title: Rocketbox · outdoor selection review
review.description: Adult candidate 2 has been replaced with a blue hooded jacket, jeans, trainers and a cap. The rejected Child candidate 3 is removed from this active selection. Eleven models are shown; its replacement is pending.
review.assessment: Outdoor clothing is the selection priority. Child slot 3 needs a newly authored child variant or another source model: the library has only three remaining stock children. Formal outfits on Adult 3 and Older 1, 2 and 3 still need replacement or body/outfit authoring. Senior age and diversity gaps also remain.

assessments.adult-03: Skirt and boots: low priority for the outdoor roster. A casual trouser outfit or a different clothed body is still needed. The requested plus-size build and middle-aged appearance remain unverified.
assessments.older-01: Formal coat and heels: low priority for the outdoor roster. This model also does not convincingly establish a senior age.
assessments.older-02: Approved senior appearance, but the blazer outfit needs an outdoor body/outfit replacement. Exact age and the requested heavy build are unverified.
assessments.older-03: Business outfit: low priority for the outdoor roster. It also does not establish an 81-year-old appearance or the requested medium-deep skin tone and thin build.
